description: This file defines models and logic for 'account.analytic.line' and a report view related to analytic lines and timesheet invoices in an Odoo module.

classes.name: account_analytic_line
classes.description: Model representing analytic lines with fields, constraints, and methods for search, validation, and onchange behavior.

classes.name: timesheet_invoice
classes.description: Model representing a database view for reporting analytic account costs and revenues, with initialization SQL.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Overrides the search method to filter by date range if specified in context.

methods.name: _check_company
methods.description: Validates that the analytic line's move and account belong to the same company.

methods.name: on_change_unit_amount
methods.description: Calculates amount and sets general account based on product and unit amount.

methods.name: view_header_get
methods.description: Generates header text for views based on the associated analytic account.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates or replaces the SQL view for the timesheet invoice report.
